periods.standing: Standing context — fixed or slow-moving before the term begins
periods.prior: Prior term (t−1) — environment, household and the mediators they drive

edges.mechanism: Distance, terrain, bus frequency and fare cost rise from urban to rural to estate
edges.concern: Sector is a proxy for structural neglect; must not read as a trait of rural/estate families

edges.mechanism: Deployment, subject specialists and medium-of-instruction coverage thin out outside urban schools
edges.confounders: Teacher preference; school size; political allocation
edges.concern: Risk of ranking or penalising schools for a resourcing failure not of their making

edges.mechanism: Water supply, toilet ratios and MHM facilities weaker in small rural/estate schools
edges.confounders: School age and size; capital budget cycles
edges.concern: Same as #2; also dignity-sensitive

edges.mechanism: Income pressure converts into paid work and unpaid household/sibling care
edges.confounders: Local labour demand; household composition; shocks
edges.concern: Must never trigger punitive action against families (§11)

edges.mechanism: Food insecurity driven by income
edges.confounders: Food prices; agricultural season; safety nets
edges.concern: Node conflates nutrition and illness (C7)

edges.mechanism: Ability to pay fares
Capacity to help with schoolwork and to negotiate with the school
edges.confounders: Intergenerational SES; parental literacy in medium of instruction
edges.modifiable: Not for the child — but substitutable via school support
edges.concern: Must be read as opportunity, not as how much a family values education. Deficit framing is the main hazard in this whole model

edges.mechanism: A present caregiver can supervise and advocate
edges.concern: Migrant-worker families (esp. mothers abroad) must not be stigmatised

edges.mechanism: Absent caregiver transfers household and sibling care to the child
edges.concern: Gendered burden is invisible without a gender variable (C4)

edges.mechanism: Different learners need different things from the setting
edges.modifiable: No, and never a do() target
edges.concern: Appropriate *only* with the accommodation interaction present; otherwise becomes "neurodivergence causes dropout"

edges.mechanism: Accommodations close the gap between need and provision
edges.confounders: Teacher capacity; school leadership; catchment SES
edges.concern: Under-provision must not be recoded as student deficit

edges.mechanism: Sustained unmet need is distressing
edges.concern: Distress is not a diagnosis; must not enter any health record without consent

edges.mechanism: Noise, crowding, heat, lighting raise load
edges.confounders: Class size; building age; correlates with #2, #3

edges.mechanism: Peer victimisation is directly distressing
edges.concern: Must never be recorded in a way that identifies or penalises the victim

edges.mechanism: Water and sanitation quality drive illness episodes
Indignity, lack of privacy, MHM barriers, sensory discomfort
edges.concern: Population-averaging a sharply gender-specific mechanism misrepresents it for all students

edges.mechanism: Cannot reliably get to school
Needed elsewhere during school hours
edges.concern: Detection must trigger support, never prosecution of the family

edges.mechanism: Illness and hunger prevent attendance
edges.concern: Health data is special-category (§11)

edges.mechanism: School avoidance as a response to a distressing setting
edges.concern: Must be framed as avoidance, never as truancy or defiance

edges.mechanism: Avoidance of academic failure and shame
Strong term-to-term persistence in habit and circumstance
edges.concern: Its dominance means the model largely re-flags the already-flagged

edges.mechanism: Practical inability to attend
Distress-driven non-attendance
Lost instructional time depresses attainment
Teaching capacity drives learning
edges.concern: Do not convert into school league tables

edges.mechanism: Scaffolding and homework supervision
edges.concern: Deficit-framing hazard as #7

edges.mechanism: Falling behind is stressful
Public-examination stakes amplify stress
Work that feels impossible erodes effort
Encouragement sustains engagement
edges.concern: As #7

edges.mechanism: Social unsafety destroys belonging
edges.concern: As #14

edges.mechanism: Chronic absence is the classic precursor
edges.concern: Dominant driver; near-tautological if the outcome is attendance-defined (C1)

edges.mechanism: Disengagement precedes leaving
edges.concern: Double counting inflates the highest-risk profile

edges.mechanism: Structural exit points at Grade 5 and O-Level
edges.concern: Carries C2's aggregation problem; the least interpretable edge in the model

edges.mechanism: Poverty concentrated in estate/rural sectors
edges.concern: Corrects an under-estimate of estate risk (C9)

edges.mechanism: Accommodations need trained staff, time and sited specialist support
edges.concern: Makes accommodation *confounded*, so §8's distinction stops being vacuous

edges.mechanism: Accommodations need trained staff, time and sited specialist support
edges.concern: Makes accommodation *confounded*, so §8's distinction stops being vacuous

edges.mechanism: Neurodivergent students are victimised at markedly higher rates
edges.concern: Encodes what is done to students, not what they cause. Must be presented as victimisation

edges.mechanism: Schools that accommodate well also supervise and intervene better
A distressed student disengages; the affective route to belonging
edges.concern: Restores a pathway whose absence made the model blind to inclusion (C5)

edges.mechanism: Unaccommodated need blocks curriculum access
edges.concern: The most important omission in the brief: accommodations exist primarily so a student can *learn*

baseline.interpretation: A large shift at the first mediator that arrives at the outcome as a small one is attenuation, not absence. If the outcome shift is below the resolution a review team can act on, the model cannot see its own most important modifiable lever and the structure or parameters must change.

amendedAttendance.interpretation: A large shift at the first mediator that arrives at the outcome as a small one is attenuation, not absence. If the outcome shift is below the resolution a review team can act on, the model cannot see its own most important modifiable lever and the structure or parameters must change. NOTE: the shift GROWS at Next_Term_Dropout_Risk, which is impossible along a single route. 4 distinct directed paths run from Support_Mismatch to Next_Term_Dropout_Risk in this variant, so signal is arriving outside this chain and transmission_to_outcome is a total across all routes rather than an attenuation factor for this one.

observational_vs_interventional.explanation: 'Bullying_Social_Exclusion' has no parents in this DAG, so no back-door path exists and the mutilated graph equals the original. The two quantities coincide *as a consequence of the assumed structure*, not as a general fact -- in reality schools do not assign this variable at random.

'Child_Labour_Household_Duties' has parents ['Economic_Strain', 'Parent_Availability'], so conditioning on it also carries information back up those edges. do() cuts them, which is why the two quantities differ here.
'Food_Health_Burden' has parents ['Economic_Strain', 'WASH_Quality'], so conditioning on it also carries information back up those edges. do() cuts them, which is why the two quantities differ here.

immutable_intervention_guardrail.refused_with: Refusing to intervene on non-modifiable variable(s) ['Neuro_Type']. do() is restricted to modifiable school/household factors: ['Bullying_Social_Exclusion', 'Child_Labour_Household_Duties', 'Food_Health_Burden', 'Home_Educational_Support', 'School_Accommodation', 'Sensory_Environment', 'Teacher_Resource_Adequacy', 'Transport_Burden', 'WASH_Quality']. Immutable or protected characteristics such as ['Grade_Band', 'Neuro_Type', 'Parent_Education', 'Sector'] are never valid intervention targets.

library_caveat.conclusion: pgmpy.CausalInference.query disagrees with truncated factorisation whenever the conditioning variable lies outside its chosen adjustment set. estimate_intervention_effect therefore computes do() on the mutilated graph and uses pgmpy only as a no-evidence cross-check.

limitations: One-at-a-time perturbation of a single parameter group is the weakest form of sensitivity analysis. It cannot detect compensating or interacting misspecification; joint perturbation and full sensitivity functions (Chan & Darwiche style) are required before any deployment claim.
Rank stability under +/-10% is necessary, not sufficient. The structure itself -- which edges exist at all -- dominates parameter uncertainty here.
The +/-10% band is arbitrary and is not an elicited credible interval. Real expert uncertainty on several of these parameters is far wider.
